entry.title: Oracle October 2026 Critical Patch Update Addresses 1209 CVEs
entry.content:
vulnerability · multiple

Oracle's October 2026 Critical Patch Update addresses 1209 CVEs across 33 product families, with 112 critical-severity patches representing 8.6% of total patches released. Oracle Fusion Middleware and E-Business Suite received the most patches (206 and 194 respectively), with 134 and 31 remote exploits without authentication required. The high prevalence of remotely exploitable critical vulnerabilities in Fusion Middleware (95 of 206 patches) and Siebel CRM (66 of 122 patches) indicates immediate risk. Apply all relevant patches from this CPU immediately, prioritizing critical updates for Fusion Middleware and E-Business Suite deployments.

entry.title: Pillow: Heap buffer overflow in ImagingJpegDecode (CVE-2026-112403)
entry.content:
vulnerability · heap-buffer-overflow · CVE-2026-112403

Pillow's `JpegImageFile.draft()` method used by `Image.thumbnail()` contains a critical heap buffer overflow in `ImagingJpegDecode()` that fails to validate JPEG decoder output dimensions against the allocated decode buffer. The vulnerability occurs when requesting scaled JPEG output (1/2, 1/4, or 1/8) because the buffer allocation does not account for actual output parameters set by `jpeg_start_decompress()`. This flaw can be exploited remotely via specially crafted JPEG files to achieve arbitrary code execution. Users should immediately update Pillow to the latest patched version.

entry.content:
vulnerability · credential-compromise

UpdraftCentral, a WordPress management tool used to remotely administer WordPress sites, had authentication keys compromised following a breach of TeamUpdraft's infrastructure. The stolen keys allow attackers to send arbitrary commands to WordPress installations connected through UpdraftCentral, enabling complete site compromise. This vulnerability is actively exploited in the wild with confirmed backdooring of WordPress sites. Immediately revoke and regenerate all UpdraftCentral connection keys, audit sites for unauthorized activity, and monitor for suspicious commands sent through the platform; consider temporarily disconnecting UpdraftCentral until key rotation is complete.

entry.title: uv's bundled CA store trusts an emSign root whose intermediate CA keys are compromised
entry.content:
vulnerability · tls-trust-store

Python dependency manager uv bundles compromised CA root certificates in its vendored webpki-root-certs store. Versions prior to 0.13.4 include emSign ECC Root CA - G3, which has eight intermediate CAs with compromised private keys that eMudhra has revoked; attackers with these keys can issue valid certificates for any hostname to perform MITM attacks. This is critical severity with potential for exploitation in the wild. Update to uv 0.13.4 or later immediately to remove the vulnerable root from the trusted store.

entry.title: CVE-2026-106173 Deep-Dive: FortiSIEM gRPC Path Traversal File Write RCE
entry.content:
vulnerability · path-traversal,rce · CVE-2026-106173

FortiSIEM's unauthenticated gRPC service contains a critical path traversal vulnerability (CVE-2026-106173) enabling arbitrary file writes and RCE through null-byte handling in file paths. The flaw affects FortiSIEM across multiple versions and requires no authentication, making it readily exploitable. Active exploitation in the wild has been observed based on available indicators of compromise. Immediately patch FortiSIEM to the latest patched version; as interim mitigation, restrict gRPC service access (default port 50051) to trusted networks only and monitor for suspicious file write patterns in FortiSIEM directories.

entry.title: Authentication Bypass, Remote Code Execution, and Database Read in Eptura Archibus (FIXED)
entry.content:
vulnerability · auth-bypass,rce,database-read · CVE-2026-107186, CVE-2026-107187, CVE-2026-107188

Eptura Archibus versions prior to 2025.02 contain three chained vulnerabilities in its Java Direct Web Remoting (DWR) API: an authentication bypass (CVE-2026-107186, CVSS 8.6) allowing unauthenticated workflow execution, full database read access (CVE-2026-107187, CVSS 8.5) to extract credentials and sensitive data, and unrestricted file upload (CVE-2026-107188, CVSS 9.6 Critical) enabling remote code execution as NT AUTHORITY/Local Service. These vulnerabilities are exploitable by network-adjacent attackers with HTTP access and were actively exploited on a customer system during discovery; no evidence of widespread wild exploitation is documented. Immediate patching to Archibus 2025.02 or later is required, as the vulnerable DWR authentication mechanism was redesigned into a REST API in the patched version.

entry.title: Mercury: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution in /api/terminals - access control bypass (CVE-2026-111057)
entry.content:
vulnerability · access-control-bypass · CVE-2026-111057

Mercury (pip package) contains a critical access control bypass in `/api/terminals` due to a missing comma in the `BLOCKED_PATTERNS` list within `mercury_app/block_handler.py`, allowing unauthenticated attackers to spawn interactive OS-level shells on affected hosts. This vulnerability (CVE-2026-111057) is a syntax error that causes the blocklist to fail covering the `/api/terminals` endpoint. There is no indication of active exploitation in the wild at this time. Affected users should immediately upgrade to a patched version when available; as interim mitigation, restrict network access to Mercury instances or implement authentication controls at the network perimeter.

No evidence of widespread exploitation in the wild has been reported, but the attack requires only proximity to the device with no authentication barriers. Affected users should contact their ISP or device manufacturer immediately for patches; if unavailable, isolate routers to trusted networks only and disable remote management features.

vulnerability · privilege-escalation · CVE-2026-77524

KEDA (Kubernetes Event Driven Autoscaling) versions prior to patched releases contain a critical privilege escalation vulnerability (CVE-2026-77524) where a namespace admin can exploit TriggerAuthentication and ScaledObject resources to exfiltrate the KEDA operator's cluster-admin ServiceAccount token to a tenant-controlled URL. The operator token grants broad cluster-wide permissions including reading all Secrets, creating/deleting batch jobs, modifying workload scaling, and updating validating webhooks, enabling complete cluster compromise. This vulnerability is critical severity and should be assumed exploitable given the straightforward attack chain. Immediately upgrade KEDA to patched versions and restrict namespace admin permissions; review audit logs for TriggerAuthentication abuse and monitor for suspicious outbound connections from KEDA operator pods.

entry.title: Threat Actor Abuses Agentic AI Pentesting Framework to Target South Korean Financial Institutions
entry.content:
red-team · agentic-ai-framework

Threat actors abused ARTEX, an open-source agentic AI pentesting framework, to target South Korean financial institutions by automating reconnaissance, vulnerability identification, and exploitation against peripheral web applications. The campaign, attributed with moderate confidence to a financially motivated Chinese-speaking actor, exploited SQL injection and authentication bypass vulnerabilities in customer-facing portals and employee backends, exfiltrating PII for approximately 67,000 individuals with high impact. Organizations should isolate any locally deployed pentesting frameworks from production environments, avoid storing production credentials in open-source tools, implement Zero Trust architecture with least-privilege access controls, deploy deception controls to detect AI-driven reconnaissance, and enforce rate limiting and authorization checks on external portals to prevent enumeration attacks. Monitor for outbound API calls to LLM services (DeepSeek, Anthropic, Zhipu) and high-frequency automated requests with sequential enumeration patterns as behavioral indicators of compromise.

Organizations running WebAlliance eCommerce should immediately block access to /preapproval.asmx endpoint as a temporary mitigation and contact Channel Software for a patched version, as the vendor has not released a fix as of October 2026.

entry.title: From One Account to Every Mailbox: Breaking Zimbra's Identity Boundaries (Part 1)
entry.content:
vulnerability · multi · CVE-2026-10631, CVE-2026-50055, CVE-2026-73571, CVE-2026-93635, CVE-2026-93637

Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains five account-related vulnerabilities affecting authentication, mailbox authorization, and mail filtering: CVE-2026-93637 (GraphQL authentication rate-limit bypass, CVSS 3.7), CVE-2026-93635 (LDAP filter injection, CVSS 5.3), CVE-2026-73571 (email impersonation via SaveDraftRequest, CVSS 8.3), CVE-2026-10631 (EWS cross-user mailbox access, CVSS 6.5), and CVE-2026-50055 (Sieve notify forwarding-restriction bypass, CVSS 6.5). CVE-2026-73571, CVE-2026-10631, and CVE-2026-50055 are confirmed fixed in ZCS 10.1.17–10.1.20; fixes for CVE-2026-93637 and CVE-2026-93635 were not publicly listed at publication. No evidence of active exploitation in the wild is mentioned, but the high-severity email impersonation flaw and the cross-user mailbox access vulnerability allow full account compromise chains when chained with subsequent findings. Affected organizations must immediately upgrade to ZCS 10.1.20 or later, inspect existing Sieve rules for illicit notify actions, and review EWS access logs for suspicious cross-account operations.

entry.content:

entry.title: Payload: Field access control bypass on auth collections (CVE-2026-105851)
entry.content:
vulnerability · auth-bypass · CVE-2026-105851, CVE-2026-105857, CVE-2026-105859, CVE-2026-105863

Payload CMS versions prior to 3.90.0 and 4.0.0-canary.34 contain a critical field access control bypass in the duplicate operation that copies field values regardless of `access.read` or `access.create` restrictions, even when fields are marked as hidden or the `disableDuplicate` setting is enabled. This vulnerability allows attackers to access sensitive data from auth collections that should be protected by access control rules. Users must immediately upgrade to Payload >= 3.90.0 or >= 4.0.0-canary.34; as a temporary workaround, implement beforeDuplicate field hooks to clear or reset sensitive field values.

entry.title: shell-quote: `quote()` command injection via a line terminator in a token after a `{ comment }` token (CVE-2026-102422)
entry.content:
vulnerability · command-injection · CVE-2026-102422

The shell-quote npm package's quote() function is vulnerable to command injection when processing comment tokens followed by string tokens containing line terminators (CVE-2026-102422). The vulnerability allows attackers to inject arbitrary shell commands by exploiting how comment tokens are rendered as `#` characters that comment out subsequent code, with line breaks in later tokens breaking out of the comment context. This is a critical severity issue with active exploitation potential. Users should immediately update to a patched version of shell-quote that properly escapes or handles comment tokens to prevent line terminator injection.

entry.title: LibreOffice and OpenOffice Flaws Let Malicious Spreadsheets Run Code Without Macro Warnings
entry.content:
vulnerability · rce

LibreOffice and Apache OpenOffice with Java support enabled are vulnerable to arbitrary code execution via malicious spreadsheets that bypass macro security warnings. The vulnerability exploits Java integration to execute attacker code immediately upon file opening without user prompts. This is currently a proof-of-concept with no reported in-the-wild exploitation. Mitigation includes disabling Java support in LibreOffice/OpenOffice if not required, or applying security patches when available; users should also disable automatic macro execution and treat spreadsheet files from untrusted sources with caution.

entry.title: Capacitor Android and iOS: remote content can be loaded at the app origin via the internal HTTP proxy path (CVE-2026-103922)
entry.content:
vulnerability · origin-bypass · CVE-2026-103922

Capacitor (Android/iOS) contains a critical path traversal vulnerability in its WebView navigation guard that fails to validate URL paths, only checking host and scheme. An attacker can navigate to the internal HTTP proxy path (`/_capacitor_http_interceptor_`) to fetch arbitrary remote content and execute it at the application's origin, potentially enabling script injection and full app compromise. This vulnerability is critical in severity and affects Capacitor Core, Capacitor Android, Capacitor iOS, and Capacitor Swift. Users should immediately update to patched versions across all affected platforms to prevent exploitation.

entry.title: proxy-addr vulnerable to IP spoofing via IPv4-mapped IPv6 trust subnet (CVE-2026-90711)
entry.content:
vulnerability · ip-spoofing · CVE-2026-90711

The proxy-addr npm package is vulnerable to IP spoofing (CVE-2026-90711) when trust subnets are configured as IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses or IPv6 ranges with zero leading bits; affected configurations incorrectly match all IPv4 addresses rather than the intended subnet block, allowing attackers to spoof X-Forwarded-For headers. This is a critical vulnerability that enables authentication bypass and trusted proxy impersonation. Applications should immediately audit their proxy-addr configuration for affected subnet patterns (e.g., `::ffff:10.0.0.0/8` or `::/1`) and update to the patched version with corrected subnet validation logic.

entry.title: simple-git unsafe-operation guard does not block trailer command configuration (CVE-2026-102828)
entry.content:
vulnerability · command-injection · CVE-2026-102828

The npm package simple-git's default blockUnsafeOperationsPlugin fails to block the `trailer..cmd` configuration option, which Git executes as a shell command via `git interpret-trailers`. This allows attackers to achieve arbitrary command execution when an application permits untrusted values in SimpleGitOptions.config or Git inline configuration arguments. This is a critical severity vulnerability with no indication of active exploitation in the wild. Applications using simple-git should immediately update to a patched version and review any code paths accepting untrusted Git configuration values.

entry.title: simple-git: `VISUAL` editor environment variable is omitted from unsafe editor detection (CVE-2026-102829)
entry.content:
vulnerability · security-control-bypass · CVE-2026-102829

The npm package @simple-git/argv-parser fails to include the `VISUAL` environment variable in its unsafe editor detection mechanism, allowing attackers to bypass security controls that prevent command injection through editor configuration. This is a critical security control bypass in the `parseEnv` function's `vulnerabilityCheck` routine. There is no indication the vulnerability is currently exploited in the wild, but it enables arbitrary command execution when untrusted code controls the `VISUAL` environment variable. Immediately update @simple-git/argv-parser to a patched version that properly classifies `VISUAL` as an unsafe editor fallback in the allowUnsafeEditor check.

entry.title: Bildmanipulationen: Content-Signatur C2PA ausgehebelt
entry.content:
vulnerability · signature-bypass

The C2PA (Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity) content signature standard for verifying image authenticity has been bypassed by exploiting an exclusion rule that allows certain image regions to be omitted from signature calculations. The bypass leverages a technically necessary feature of the standard but enables attackers to manipulate images while maintaining valid C2PA signatures, undermining the integrity verification purpose. No active exploitation in the wild has been reported, though this represents a fundamental weakness in the standard's design rather than a software-specific vulnerability. Adobe and other C2PA implementers should collaborate on refined verification rules that balance technical necessity with security; users should not rely solely on C2PA signatures for authenticating critical content without additional verification methods.

entry.title: gitea-runner: workflow container.options passes host namespaces and capability flags to job container when privileged mode is disabled (CVE-2026-73802)
entry.content:
vulnerability · privilege-escalation · CVE-2026-73802

Gitea Runner (act_runner) fails to sanitize workflow-controlled `container.options` parameters when privileged mode is disabled, allowing attackers to bypass security restrictions. A malicious workflow can specify host namespace flags (PID/IPC) and capability expansions to gain root-level access to the runner host despite the runner operating in non-privileged mode. This is critical severity and likely exploitable given that workflows are user-controllable in many CI/CD environments. Immediately update Gitea Runner to the patched version and audit all recent workflow executions for suspicious container options usage.

A China-nexus threat actor has deployed a previously undocumented backdoor called Antino targeting government and policy organizations across seven Asian countries (Taiwan, India, Philippines, Cambodia, Pakistan, Thailand, Myanmar). The severity is high given the espionage targeting of government entities; current indicators do not specify active wild exploitation beyond the identified campaign. Recommended actions: implement email security controls and OneDrive access restrictions for sensitive networks, hunt for Antino indicators of compromise in logs, and monitor for lateral movement following initial compromise.
